---
title: Image with attributes
format: q2-preview
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      requires_js: true
    q2-preview:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # Image bytes flow through the parent-side asset walker
        # (q2-preview/assetWalker.ts), which mints a blob URL from
        # VFS bytes and posts the manifest in UPDATE_AST.
        # AssetManifestContext distributes the manifest to <Image>,
        # which looks up `hero.png` and renders <img src="blob:...">.
        - ['img[src^="blob:"]']
        - ['img[width="400"]']
        - ['img[alt="alt"]']
---
